units.source_text: “那是住在麻布笄町时的事啰……房子不大宽敞，一间十叠的房间，既是对局室又是练习场。

en.t: That was when we were living in Azabu Kogaicho... The house was not very spacious, and one ten-mat room served both as the game room and as the practice room.

units.source_text: 不妙的是贴邻八叠的房间作了茶室。

en.t: The trouble was that the adjoining eight-mat room had been made into a tea room.

units.source_text: 茶室里的客人有时放声大笑，有时吵吵嚷嚷。

en.t: The guests in the tea room would sometimes laugh loudly and sometimes make a great commotion.

units.source_text: 一回，恰巧我先生同什么人在对局，

en.t: Once, as it happened, my husband was in the middle of a game with someone,

units.source_text: 我妹妹把她刚出生的婴儿抱来让我瞧，婴儿不会考虑别人，哭个不停。

en.t: and my younger sister brought over her newborn baby to show me; babies do not think of other people, and this one kept crying without stopping.

units.source_text: 我万分焦急，希望妹妹早点回去，

en.t: I was terribly anxious and hoped my sister would leave soon,

units.source_text: 可是有一段时间没见面了，怎么好意思开口让她走呢。

en.t: but we had not seen each other for some time, so how could I bring myself to ask her to go?

units.source_text: 等妹妹走后，我向先生道歉：准是把您闹烦了吧？

en.t: After my sister left, I apologized to my husband, saying, I must have disturbed you, didn't I?

units.source_text: 先生却说，他一点也不晓得我妹妹来过，也没听见婴儿的哭闹声，

en.t: But my husband said he had not known at all that my sister had come, and had not heard the baby crying either,
That was the kind of man he was.
